pr_title: fix: api state not cleared on logout
pr_body:
### What does it do?

Fixes an issue where the app's local cache wasn't cleared when you logged out.

### Why is it needed?

Prevent one user's data from leaking to the next user to log in via the same browser

### How to test it?

Have 2 users users:
- one is a super admin with full permissions
- one is an "author" without permissions to read a specific field

You should be able to do this in the same tab without refreshing:
- login as the author user
- open the edit/create view where you removed the permissions for a field. You shouldn't see that field.
- logout
- login as super admin
- go to the same edit/create view. You should see the field

### Related issue(s)/PR(s)

fixes #20344

issue_context.title: User cache is not cleared when logging out and logging in as a different user
issue_context.body:
## Bug report

### Required System information

- Node.js version: v20
- Yarn version: v1
- Strapi version: v4.24.2
- Database: SQLite
- Operating system: Linux Mint 21.3
- Is your project Javascript or Typescript: Javascript

### Describe the bug

When logging out and logging in as a different user with different permissions, the new login will see some things related to the previous users permissions. This is corrected by refreshing the page (and doesn't leak any sensitive information) but any data fetching caches should be cleared when logging out

### Steps to reproduce the behavior

Bug report created simply to mirror DX-1416: https://strapi-inc.atlassian.net/browse/DX-1416

### Expected behavior

Data caches should be cleared

### Screenshots

N/A

N/A
